definitions.content:
name: github_release_day_change
label: GitHub on GTA 6 release day
description: 'Metric 4. Average change, in percent, of PRs opened, PRs merged and commits on GitHub on
  GTA 6''s release day (Thu 19 Nov 2026, UTC) against the Thursday before (12 Nov 2026). -5 = GitHub 5%
  quieter. Never report it alone: always with its breakdown (group by github_release_day__breakdown, or
  query github_activity_change by github_activity__activity).'
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: github_release_day_change_measure

name: github_activity_change
label: GitHub release day, change by activity
description: 'Metric 4 breakdown: one activity''s release-day count against the same weekday a week before,
  in percent. Group by github_activity__activity.'
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: github_activity_pct_change

name: github_activity_release_day
label: GitHub activity on release day
description: Metric 4. An activity's count on release day (UTC). Group by github_activity__activity.
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: github_activity_release_day_count

name: github_activity_baseline
label: GitHub activity on a normal day
description: Metric 4. An activity's count on the same weekday a week before release day (the median when
  the baseline spans more weeks). Group by github_activity__activity.
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: github_activity_baseline_count

name: github_activity_count
label: GitHub activity per day
description: 'Metrics 4 and 6. PRs opened, PRs merged or commits on GitHub per UTC day (GitHub Search
  API total_count). Always group by github_day__activity: never add across activities. NULL is unavailable,
  never zero.'
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: github_activity_count_measure
